# Taeam

> Taeam is a halal food delivery platform in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Every kitchen on Taeam is halal only, not filtered by a checkbox, and every restaurant page shows how far Taeam's paperwork check has gone. Taeam is pre-launch and taking sign-ups on a waitlist at https://taeam.ca.

Key facts:

- Name: Taeam, pronounced "tay-em". It comes from طعام, the Arabic word for food. People who hear the name sometimes spell it Tayem, Taam or Ta'am. It is a brand name, not a misspelling of "team".
- Tagline: Taste the trust (Arabic: طعم الثقة).
- What it is: a food delivery app where every restaurant is halal. Each restaurant signs that its kitchen is halal only, Taeam checks the paperwork behind that promise, and each restaurant page shows where that check stands (Under review, Owner's word, Third-party certified or Taeam Verified).
- Where: Edmonton, Alberta. Launching first in North and South Edmonton, then growing across the city.
- Status: pre-launch. Customers and drivers can join the waitlist on the website.
- Company: Taeam Technologies Inc., Edmonton, Alberta.
- Contact: contact@taeam.ca
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/taeam.ca

## Main pages

- [Home](https://taeam.ca/): what Taeam is and the launch waitlist
- [Our story](https://taeam.ca/about): why Taeam exists, and how to say the name
- [How we verify halal](https://taeam.ca/how-we-verify): the paperwork checked behind every restaurant and what each label means
- [The halal trust gap](https://taeam.ca/halal): research on why halal food in Canada is hard to trust
- [Hand or machine](https://taeam.ca/halal/hand-vs-machine): what hand slaughtered and machine slaughtered halal chicken mean
- [Halal product check](https://taeam.ca/halal-check): a free lookup for grocery products Taeam has checked
- [Check a Taeam Verified record](https://taeam.ca/verify): confirm a printed Taeam Verified certificate is current

## Products

- [Taeam Grocery](https://taeam.ca/grocery): halal groceries, checked product by product, coming soon
- [Arbaab](https://taeam.ca/arbaab): Taeam's food assistant inside the app
- [Rewards and Taeam Plus](https://taeam.ca/rewards): points on every order and a delivery membership
- [Drive with Tawsil](https://taeam.ca/drive): Tawsil is Taeam's driver app for delivery drivers in Edmonton
